service.description: An identifier for the service name

refresh.description: If `true` then refresh the affected shards to make this operation visible to search, if `wait_for` (the default) then wait for a refresh to make this operation visible to search, if `false` then do nothing with refreshes.

force.description: If `false` (the default), deleting an account that still has service tokens is rejected. If `true`, the account is deleted and its tokens are left in place; they cannot authenticate while no account of that name exists, but creating one again later revives them.
